deviations.description: Enumerate the actual Final Verification Stage mechanisms rather than the plan's asserted three-greps-plus-build list
deviations.reason: Re-reading lean-implementation-agent.md's Final Verification Stage showed five mechanisms, not the plan's asserted list of three greps plus a build: a sorry census, a vacuous-definition grep, an axiom grep, an unsandboxed lake build, AND a plan-compliance spot-check grep. The plan's own Scope Hypothesis instructed enumerating whatever is actually there, so the plan-compliance grep was included as a fifth mechanism (and its hole documented) rather than omitted to match the plan's simpler asserted count.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — enumerated five actual Final Verification Stage mechanisms, including the plan-compliance grep, rather than the plan's asserted three-greps-plus-build count)*
